title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on mobile
summary: The mobile banner change, rollout window and administrator action match Microsoft's notice. The controls and licensing statements are supported, but the page should report conflicting Microsoft guidance about queue membership and template defaults, and the warning about saving a queue in Teams admin center.

claims.claim: Assign a queue's automatic recording template in Teams admin center at Voice > Call queue > queue > Templates tab > Automatic recording template.
claims.quote:
go to Voice > Call queue.
Select the call queue you want to have automatic recording for.
On the Templates tab, scroll to find the Automatic recording template section.

claims.claim: The MicrosoftTeams Set-CsCallQueue cmdlet's AutoRecordingTemplateId parameter assigns an automatic recording template to a queue.
claims.quote:
Voice applications private preview customers only.
Saving a call queue configuration through Teams admin center will remove this setting.
The AutoRecordingTemplateId parameter indicates the Auto Recording template to apply to the call queue.
claims.fix: Add the reference warning to controls[0].note and the rendered table: 'The PowerShell reference also warns that saving a queue through Teams admin center removes this setting, whereas the setup page documents assignment through that UI.' Retain the private-preview warning and report this documentation disagreement.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; Governance controls table and closing prose
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an admin UI or API control to change or disable this mobile automatic recording banner.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams mobile call queue automatic recording indicator banner admin setting PowerShell disable wording. Opened recording setup, Set-CsCallQueue, New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate and custom compliance banner docs; the latter requires separate compliance recording policies.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Existing automatic recording templates govern queue recording and transcription rather than the new banner wording.
claims.quote: This article is for IT pros and Teams administrators who want to configure automatic recording and transcription for inbound call queue calls.

claims.claim: The automatic recording template controls caller announcements.
claims.quote: An automatic recording template for Call Queue defines where, in SharePoint, recordings and transcripts will be stored, the prompts played to callers to let them know that recording is enabled, and defines who has access to the recordings.

claims.claim: The default caller announcement is 'This call will be recorded.'
claims.quote: The default announcement is: This call will be recorded.

claims.claim: Assigning an automatic recording template to a queue requires its Teams administrator to also be a SharePoint site administrator for the template's site.
claims.quote: To assign an automatic recording template to a call queue or manage its authorized users list, the Teams administrator must also be a SharePoint site administrator for the site used by the template.

claims.claim: Recording is enabled by default when creating an automatic recording template.
claims.quote: Call recording is enabled by default. Disable call recording if required.
claims.fix: Qualify this as creation in Teams admin center: 'In Teams admin center, the recording toggle is on by default when creating a template.' Report that https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/new-csautorecordingtemplate instead lists RecordingEnabled's default as False.

claims.claim: Transcription is enabled by default when creating an automatic recording template.
claims.quote: Transcription is enabled by default. Disable transcription if required.
claims.fix: Qualify this as creation in Teams admin center: 'In Teams admin center, the transcription toggle is on by default when creating a template.' Report that https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/new-csautorecordingtemplate instead lists TranscriptionEnabled's default as False.

claims.claim: The template's SharePoint host setting cannot be changed after template creation.
claims.quote:
Enter the SharePoint host name.
Example: contoso.sharepoint.com
The host must already exist and must have been visited in a standard browser before you create the template.
This setting can't be modified once the template is created.

claims.claim: The template's SharePoint site setting cannot be changed after template creation.
claims.quote:
Enter the SharePoint site name.
The site must be provisioned through the template creation process.
This setting can't be modified once the template is created.

claims.claim: Automatic Recording for Call Queue requires conference mode enabled on the queue.
claims.quote: Conference mode is enabled on the call queue.

claims.claim: The setup page requires call answering by a group or channel.
claims.quote: Call answering must use a group or channel.
claims.fix: Report both cited pages: 'The template setup page says call answering must use a group or channel; the Automatic Recording for Call Queue prerequisites at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing instead say to use Microsoft 365 security groups to assign representatives.' Do not silently choose between the descriptions.
